title: Top LEGO Sets for Adults: Display-Worthy Builds (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: I selected sets that were highlighted in the articles, giving priority to those mentioned by more than one source (none met that criterion, so I chose the most frequently discussed and visually striking options). The sites used were CNET (source 1), Wargamer (source 5), and IGN (source 7).
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source explicitly states them; otherwise the price field is null. No external pricing or discount information was added.
